spans.s:
m. (-दः)
A plant, (Echites scholaris.) See सप्तपर्णः.
E.
अयुज् separate, and छद a leaf.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Separate, disjoined.
2 Improper.
E.
अ neg. युक्त joined.

m. (-क्तः)
A minister, an agent or deputy.
E.
आङ्, युज to join, and क्त aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Disunion, separation.
2 Unreasonableness, want of conformity to correct principles or to analogy.
3 Impropriety, unfitness.
E.
अ neg. युक्ति union.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Single, separate.
2 Odd.
E.
अ neg. युग a pair.

ind.
Gradually, seriatim, not at once.
E.
अ neg. युगपत् at once.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Single.
E.
अ neg. युगल a pair.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
Fire.
E.
अयुग uneven, (seven) अर्च्चिष् ray.

mfn. (-ग्मः-ग्मा-ग्मं)
1 Separate, divided, single.
2 Odd, uneven.
E.
अ not, युग्म a pair.

m. (-दः)
A plant, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
अ neg. युग्म double, and छद a leaf.

mfn. (-युक)
1 Separate, single.
2 Odd, uneven.
E.
अ neg. युज् what joins.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disjoined, detached.
n. (-तं)
Ten thousand.
E.
अ neg. and यत joined, counted.

n. (-द्धं)
Peace, absence of war.
E.
अ neg. युद्ध war.

m. (-षः)
End of life, death.
E.
आयुस् and शेष end.

mn. (-युः-यु)
Age, duration of life.
E.
अय to go, Uṇādi affix डु.

m. (-धः)
A weapon in general.
E.
आङ्, युध to fight, क aff.

f. (-णी)
A plant, (Aeschynomene sesban): see जयन्ती.
E.
आयुध a weapon, and धर्म्मिणी possessing virtue: having the virtues of a weapon against disease, &c.

n. (-रं)
An arsenal, an armoury.
E.
आयुध and आगार a house.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to arms.
m. (-कः)
A soldier, a warrior.
E.
आयुध a weapon, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to or connected with weapons.
m. (-यः)
A warrior.
E.
आयुध and छण् aff.

n. (-व्यं)
A medicament.
E.
आयुस् life, and द्रव्य thing.

m. (-दः)
1 The science of medicine.
2 The collective writings of authority on medicine, or medical Śāstra.
E.
आयस् life, and वेद a Veda.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Acquainted with medical science.
E.
आयुर्वेद and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Belonging to medicine, of the medical profession, medical, medicinal, &c.
m. (-दी)
A practiser of physic, a physician or surgeon.
E.
आयुर्वेद and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मती-ष्मत्)
1 Alive, living.
2 Long lived.
m. (-ष्मान्)
One of the twenty-seven Yogas or divisions of the ecliptic.
E.
आयुस् age, and मतुप् possessive aff.

m. (-मः)
A sacrifice to obtain longevity.
E.
आयुस् and ष्टोम a sacrifice.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Vital, preservative of life, for the sake of life, relating or belonging to it.
E.
आयुस् and यत् aff.

m. (-युः)
Age, duration of life.
E.
इ to go, उसि Uṇādi affix, the pen. lengthened.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Promoting longevity, supporting life.
E.
आयुस् and कर what makes.
